evaluator.run: function run(id,state={},timeout){const st={...state},events=[];function act(xs){for(const a of xs){if(a.type==="SET_VARIABLE")st[a.variableId]=value(a.variableValue,st);else if(a.type==="CONDITIONAL"){for(const b of a.conditionalBlocks)if(!b.condition||value(b.condition,st)){act(b.actions);break}}else events.push(a)}}for(const r of by[id].reactions||[])if(timeout===undefined||Math.abs((r.trigger.timeout||0)-timeout)<.001)act(r.actions);return {state:st,events}}
